verdict.rationale: Unreal ships multiple documented scriptable interfaces: the Python Editor Scripting API for creating/editing assets and automating tasks, the Remote Control REST/WebSocket API for calling any Blueprint-callable function and editing properties remotely, and UAT/command-line tooling for cooking, packaging and triggering builds — together covering scene/node creation, property editing, and build automation programmatically. Missing for 10: no official first-party MCP or agent-native wrapper, and probe evidence shows the docs/API endpoints are sometimes WAF-gated (intermittent 403s for non-browser clients) which undermines reliable machine/agent access despite the capability existing.
